title: Baker Victory Services day treatment center as a front for defense psychic research
summary: Jordan Jose tells of Baker Victory Services day treatment center as a front for defense psychic research, about 2008–2010 at 650 Ridge Road, Western New York (Baker Victory Services), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: 650 Ridge Road, Western New York (Baker Victory Services)

tellings.quote: And that game began a two-year journey to where I attended school into a uh nondescript uh since been shut down, sued six ways to Sunday uh school that was from the outside serving neurode divergent um and behavioral health kids uh but on the inside was supporting um a mission for defense contractor research for psychic potential uh development.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose says that from about 2008 to 2010, as a child, he attended a school at 650 Ridge Road in Western New York run by Baker Victory Services, a day treatment centre that has since closed after many lawsuits. He says that from the outside it served neurodivergent kids and kids with behavioural needs, but on the inside it supported research by a defense contractor into developing psychic abilities, a journey he says began with a game. If true, it would mean children were quietly being tested for psychic potential for the military.
